author: Tynvale
body:
This is a map made by myself and Eric for Avicus 9th Building Event, Sculptoris.
Any helpful feedback would be much appreciated.

Map Name: Chiizu (Means smile in Japanese)
Map Gamemode: Destroy the Monument
Map Creators: Tynvale, MapDev (Eric)
Map Helper: EMBY

Map Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/aycyhmydxsa9dt8/xdxd.rar
Full album of images: http://imgur.com/a/h5GKz
YAML: http://pastebin.com/sYZvGsiC

Info:
- The teams sizes are 16v16
- Team colours are Green and Purple
- Every kill will also get you 2 iron ingots since there are no ores on the map, this is because the event limited us to block types for the map.
- The teams names are Shio and Kosho
